continuity: The Green Forest Alliance’s betrayal is suspected by villagers, who cite a Blue Flower Escort Bureau flag recovered from a landslide as evidence of an attack and cover-up; the chapter does not confirm who caused the landslide.
Pa Ryun leads hundreds of ships and thousands of men toward the Great Nation’s warships.
plot: Villagers connect a blocked mountain road and a recovered Blue Flower Escort Bureau flag to a suspected Green Forest Alliance attack, and fear the Alliance may betray its official allies. They also discuss reports that the Murong Family joined Dark Heaven. Pa Ryun recounts how imperial troops killed the old man who raised him, leading him to reject the Son of Heaven’s claim to rule; he now leads a fleet toward the Great Nation’s warships.
translation_decisions: Render 청화 표국 as Blue Flower Escort Bureau.

active_continuity: Villagers suspect the Green Forest Alliance attacked the Blue Flower Escort Bureau and covered it up with a landslide; this remains unconfirmed.
A Blue Flower Escort Bureau flag was recovered from the landslide that blocked the mountain road.
Villagers report that the Murong Family joined forces with Dark Heaven.
Pa Ryun leads hundreds of ships and thousands of men toward the Great Nation’s warships.
Pa Ryun rejects the Son of Heaven’s claim to rule; imperial troops killed the old man who raised him when Pa Ryun was twelve.
open_questions: Who is the black-robed captive in Qinghai, and what does he know?
Why did the Lord of Heaven spare Taekyung in Gansu, and what is his real purpose?
Will the Alliance Leader and other righteous warriors reach Qinghai?
What is the hidden ember Cheongheoja warned about?
Who is the black-robed man beside Pa Ryun?

names.notes: Name on the flag of the Blue Flower Escort Bureau.
